distribution.summary: Fujian; Guangdong; Guangxi; Jiangxi; Yunnan; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi and Jiangxi. Lin & Smith (2022) adds Taiwan. Smith et al. (2022) adds Yunnan, with locality evidence from Wenshan.

host_note: The additional hosts from Lin & Smith (2022) are retained at the source-reported resolution and spelling; no silent taxonomic correction is applied.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Anisandrus ursulus (Eggers, 1923).

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus lativentris
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 191.

taxonomic_history.name: Anisandrus ursulus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Lin & Smith (2022) adds Taiwan occurrence and additional source-supported host records; the stable VSN remains unchanged.
